trHeroFoot.japan_und_china_seit_jahren: Japan and China. Seen only on screens for years. Here is my plan and a question for you.
trAskTitle.wuerdest_du_mich_dabei_unters: Would you support me on the way?
frage.kein_geld_keine_anmeldung_kein: No money, no sign-up, no catch. Just yes or no. I want to know if anyone out there is rooting for this before I plan the next step.
trDankJa.dein_ja_ist_ein_stempel: Your yes is one more stamp in the passport. Nothing else happens, promise.
trDankNein.danke_dass_du_ehrlich_warst: Thanks for being honest. You're still welcome to fly along.

trMarquee.die_sechs_stationen_der_reise: The six stops of the journey
trReiseIntro.sechs_orte_zwei_laender_ein: Six places, two countries, one route. Scroll, and you fly along.
stTokio.an_der_shibuyakreuzung_stehen_we: Standing at the Shibuya crossing when the lights change and hundreds of people start walking at once. Then on through alleys barely wide enough for a food stall.
stTokio.die_shibuyakreuzung_in_tokio_zur: The Shibuya crossing in Tokyo at blue hour, people crossing in every direction
stTokio.bunte_neonschilder_ueber_einer_s: Colourful neon signs above a street in Kabukichō, Shinjuku
stTokio.tokio_bei_nacht_von_oben: Tokyo at night from above, Tokyo Tower glowing in the middle
stTokio.eine_wand_aus_leuchtreklamen_am: A wall of illuminated signs along the Dōtonbori canal in Osaka
stKyoto.frueh_aufstehen_bevor_die_busse: Getting up early, before the buses arrive. Up the mountain through the red gates of Fushimi Inari, until it gets quiet.
stKyoto.ein_weg_durch_dicht_stehende: A path through densely packed red torii gates with a lantern at Fushimi Inari, Kyoto
stKyoto.hohe_gruene_bambusstaemme_im_bam: Tall green bamboo stalks in the Arashiyama bamboo forest
stKyoto.eine_leere_gasse_mit_holzhaeuser: An empty lane with wooden houses and paper umbrellas in Kyoto
stKyoto.der_kiyomizuderatempel_zwischen_: Kiyomizu-dera temple among red autumn trees
stFuji.einmal_den_berg_sehen_der: Seeing the mountain from every other postcard with my own eyes. Ideally on a clear morning, with a vending machine coffee in hand.
stFuji.das_tor_im_meer_miyajima: The gate in the sea, Miyajima
stFuji.der_fuji_mit_schneekappe_im: Snow-capped Mount Fuji in the evening light, a calm lake in pastel colours in front
stFuji.blick_ueber_gruene_huegel_auf: View across green hills to Mount Fuji under clouds
stFuji.ein_zweig_mit_weissen_kirschbluet: A branch with white cherry blossoms against a dark background
stFuji.das_rote_torii_von_itsukushima: The red torii of Itsukushima standing in the water at sunset
stPeking.auf_der_grossen_mauer_laufen: Walking the Great Wall where the steps get steep and hardly anyone keeps up. Then back into the city, to the Forbidden City and a plate of jiaozi.
stPeking.die_grosse_mauer_bei_jinshanlin: The Great Wall at Jinshanling runs over green mountains with its watchtowers
stPeking.die_daecher_des_kaiserpalasts_i: The roofs of the Forbidden City in Beijing in the evening haze
stPeking.die_runde_halle_der_ernteopfer: The round Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests at the Temple of Heaven in Beijing
stPeking.die_grosse_mauer_bei_badaling: The Great Wall at Badaling winding over wooded hills
stZhangjiajie.die_felsnadeln_die_aussehe: The rock pillars that look like they come from a film. I want to know if they really float in the mist like in the pictures.
stZhangjiajie.steile_sandsteinsaeulen_mi: Steep sandstone pillars with trees on top in Zhangjiajie
stZhangjiajie.ein_tal_voller_felssaeulen: A valley full of rock pillars at Huangshizhai in Zhangjiajie
stZhangjiajie.der_lifluss_windet_sich_zw: The Li River winding between karst hills near Yangshuo
stZhangjiajie.reihen_von_terrakottakrieg: Rows of terracotta warriors in Xi’an
stShanghai.am_bund_stehen_wenn_in: Standing on the Bund when the lights come on in Pudong. The old waterfront on one side, the future on the other.
stShanghai.die_beleuchtete_skyline_von_p: The illuminated Pudong skyline in Shanghai at night with the Oriental Pearl Tower
stShanghai.die_skyline_von_pudong_in: The Pudong skyline in Shanghai from the waterfront, by day
stShanghai.eine_rosaweisse_lotusbluete_i: A pink and white lotus flower in a pond in Shanghai
stShanghai.verkehr_und_leuchtreklamen_au: Traffic and neon signs on a street in Shinjuku at night
plan.sechs_stationen_noch_ohne_datum: Six stops, no dates yet. The order is set, the rest grows with every yes.

trPlanTrack.tempel_am_morgen_bambuswald_: Temples in the morning, bamboo forest in the afternoon.
trPlanTrack.ein_tag_am_kawaguchisee_den: A day at Lake Kawaguchi with the mountain in view.
trPlanTrack.grosse_mauer_kaiserpalast_hi: Great Wall, Forbidden City, Temple of Heaven.
trPlanTrack.felsnadeln_im_nebel_und_die: Rock pillars in the mist and the glass bridge, if I dare.
trPlanTrack.zum_schluss_der_bund_bei: The Bund at night to finish, then the long flight home.

trBriefText.ich_bin_sven_ich_mache: I'm Sven. I'm doing my apprenticeship right now and build MyWorkLog on the side, on my own, in the evenings and at weekends.
trBriefText.japan_und_china_sind_seit: For years, Japan and China have been where my thoughts drift when I need a break. For an apprentice, a trip like this is no weekend getaway. Flights, accommodation and time are a big goal for me right now.
trBriefText.warum_diese_seite_weil_traeu: Why this page? Because dreams nobody knows about quietly fade away. If you say yes, I know someone out there is rooting for it. That means more than you might think.

trip.name: My travel dream: Japan and China
trip.description: A planned trip through six places in Japan and China, from Tokyo via Kyoto and Mount Fuji to Beijing, Zhangjiajie and Shanghai, about 23,300 km from Frankfurt and back.
